test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The old castle, with its towering walls, creaky gates, and secret passages, was the __perfect example__ of a medieval fortress.
solution: The correct answer is: **Epitome** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Epitome **means a perfect example or representation of something. (किसी चीज़ का आदर्श उदाहरण या प्रतिनिधित्व) • **Example**: *Her grace and poise were the epitome of elegance.* • It is a suitable substitute for the underlined segment in the sentence. • The word is commonly used to describe something that is the best or most typical example of a particular category. • In this sentence, "**epitome**" emphasizes that the castle embodies all the characteristics of a medieval fortress. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Epicentre** means the central point of something, usually a disaster or an event. (किसी चीज़ का केंद्रीय बिंदु, आमतौर पर कोई आपदा या घटना) • **Crux **means the most important or decisive point of an issue or problem. (किसी मुद्दे या समस्या का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण या निर्णायक बिंदु) • **Antithesis **means the direct opposite or contrast of something. (किसी चीज़ का सीधा विपरीत या विरोधाभास) 39:T931, The correct answer is: **Effect**
